name: The Israelite Servant Girl
title: The Girl Who Directed Naaman to the Prophet
summary: A young Israelite girl was taken captive as a war prisoner and served the wife of the Aramean commander Naaman. She told them that there was a prophet in Samaria who could heal Naaman's leprosy—a testimony that led to his healing.

keyEvents.title: Directing Naaman to the Prophet
keyEvents.description: The little servant girl told Naaman's wife about the prophet in Samaria who could heal her husband's leprosy.
